skills.description: 与本地 OpenAI Codex 进行专业多轮工程协商、架构方案碰撞（RFC）、主从派工执行、对抗式交叉代码审查（Code Review）与疑难排障，并将全过程实时同步至右侧辅助栏「Codex 对讲室」。当用户要求与 Codex 讨论、让 Codex 执行改码、互审代码、双 AI 辩论或打开对讲室时激活此技能。

readmeMarkdown:
**English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) [![CI](https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Node.js >= 22.5](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.5.0-5fa04e)](https://nodejs.org/) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-007acc)](#) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-informational)](#) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) [![LINUX DO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Community-LINUX%20DO-f0a500?logo=discourse&logoColor=white)](https://linux.do/) **Turn Google Antigravity into a Multi-Agent Command Center & Peer-Review Roundtable.** Connect **OpenAI Codex**, **Pi Coding Agent**, **Anthropic Claude Code**, **Google Gemini CLI**, **OpenCode**, and **any custom CLI coding agent** inside Antigravity's native right-hand Auxiliary Pane — with **0 external npm dependencies**.
--- ## Why `antigravity-agent-bridge`? Talking directly to GPT / Codex with rough, conversational prompts often feels clunky — whereas brainstorming naturally with **Gemini inside Google Antigravity**, letting Gemini synthesize a rigorous, context-complete engineering prompt, and then handing that spec to **OpenAI Codex** (or **Claude Code** / **Pi**) to execute produces dramatically better results. Previously, doing this meant manually copy-pasting prompts and `git diff`s across multiple windows. **`antigravity-agent-bridge`** automates this exact workflow natively inside **Google Antigravity**: - **Native Aux-Pane Roundtable UI**: Embeds directly into Antigravity's right-hand Sidecar pane, binding live to Antigravity's `:root` theme CSS variables (`Light`, `Dark`, and custom themes update in the exact same frame with zero visual seam) and following your active Antigravity conversation **1:1**. - **5 Built-In Streaming Agent Drivers + Extensible Custom Adapters**: | Agent | CLI Binary | Streaming Protocol | Stateful Session Resume | Read-Only / Write Sandboxing | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **OpenAI Codex** | `codex` | Persistent `app-server --stdio` JSON-RPC v2 | `thread/resume` + safe `thread/fork` | `--sandbox` + live approval cards | | **Pi Agent** | `pi` | `pi --mode json -p` NDJSON | `--session-id ` | `--tools read,grep,find,ls` vs full | | **Claude Code** | `claude` | `claude -p --output-format stream-json` | `--resume ` | `--permission-mode plan` vs `acceptEdits` | | **Gemini CLI** | `gemini` | `gemini -p --output-format stream-json` | `--resume ` | Read-only vs `--yolo` | | **OpenCode** | `opencode` | `opencode run --format json` | `-s ` | Scoped workspace execution | | **Custom CLI** | *Any CLI* | Declarative `agents.custom.json` | Optional template | Custom args (`Aider`, `Qwen`, `Goose`…) | - **Parallel Multi-Agent Council ("群策圆桌")**: Broadcast one architectural RFC or uncommitted `git diff` to **all installed agents in parallel** (`--agent council` or `--agents codex,pi,claude`), watching each agent stream its independent verdict into the same room. - **Adaptive Convergence-Driven Rounds (`1..N`)**: No rigid "2-round" or "3-round" limits — Antigravity autonomously governs the number of discussion or review-fix-verify rounds based on task complexity and peer convergence signals (`[PEER_STATUS: CONVERGED | NEEDS_ROUND]`, `[PEER_VERDICT: PASS | CHANGES_REQUIRED]`), stopping in 1 round when aligned or iterating 4+ rounds until every `P0/P1` issue is resolved. - **Architect → Executor Dispatch**: Tell Antigravity in plain language: *"Design the plan yourself, dispatch implementation & tests to Codex / Pi / Claude, and iterate review-and-fix rounds until the diff passes."* - **Bidirectional Peer Skills**: Installs `agent-bridge` & `codex-chat` into Antigravity **and** automatically installs the reverse `antigravity-chat` skill into `~/.codex/skills/`, `~/.pi/agent/skills/`, and `~/.claude/skills/` so external agents can consult local Antigravity (`agy`) too — guarded by `AGY_CODEX_PEER_CALL=1` hardware-level anti-recursion locks. --- ## 30-Second Quickstart (Windows / macOS / Linux / WSL 2) **Prerequisites**: - **Node.js `>= 22.5.0`** (uses built-in `node:sqlite` — zero C++ native compilation or `npm install` bloat!) - [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google) + **at least one** coding agent CLI (`codex`, `pi`, `claude`, `gemini`, or `opencode`). ### macOS / Linux / WSL 2 ```bash git clone https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge.git "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-bridge" cd "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-bridge" npm run setup npm run doctor ``` ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-bridge" cd "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-bridge" npm run setup npm run doctor ``` Then simply talk to Antigravity in plain language: - *"Open the Aux-Pane Roundtable and debate our database sharding design with **Codex** until you both converge on the schema."* - *"Design the API contract yourself, dispatch implementation and unit tests to **Pi** (or **Claude Code**), and iterate until your diff review passes."* - *"Run a parallel **Council** code review (`Codex + Pi + Claude`) on my uncommitted Git changes."* --- ## Architecture Overview ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Google Antigravity\n(Main Chat + Architect)"] <-->|"agent-bridge / codex-chat\n+ Aux-Pane Sidecar HTTP"| B["Universal Bridge Kernel\n(PID Leases · Epoch Fencing · SQLite WAL)"] B <--> C1["OpenAI Codex\n(app-server RPC)"] B <--> C2["Pi Agent\n(--mode json)"] B <--> C3["Claude Code\n(stream-json)"] B <--> C4["Gemini CLI / OpenCode\n+ Custom JSON Adapters"] ``` ### Adding Any Custom CLI Agent in 10 Lines (`agents.custom.json`) Copy [`agents.example.json`](./agents.example.json) to `agents.custom.json` inside the plugin root to register **Aider**, **Qwen Code**, **Goose**, **Cursor Agent**, or internal enterprise tools — they immediately light up in both the Sidecar UI picker and `talk_agent.mjs`! --- ## CLI Usage & Diagnostics ```bash # Inspect all detected coding agents, models, and health checks: npm run doctor # Run the 17 automated concurrency, path-sandbox, NDJSON streaming & HTTP long-polling tests: npm test # Cleanly remove reverse peer skills from ~/.codex, ~/.pi, and ~/.claude: npm run uninstall-bridge ``` --- ## Community, Contributing & License - **Community Acknowledgment**: Proudly shared with and supported by the **[LINUX DO](https://linux.do/)** developer community. - **Contributing**: Contributions, new agent adapters, and issue reports are warmly welcome! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md). - **License**: Released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).
latestReleaseNotes:
### Bug Fixes
- **Eliminate Duplicate Codex Threads Across Multi-Round Discussions**: Fixed a sticky `meta.cwd` bug (`prevMeta.cwd || chosenCwd`) when CLI peer turns (`talk_agent.mjs` / `talk_codex.mjs`) run with `persistPrefs: false`. Previously, once a room switched from Project Folder A to Project Folder B, `meta.cwd` stayed frozen at Folder A, causing Round 2, Round 3...N in Folder B to falsely detect `cwdChanged === true` and spawn a brand-new Codex thread on every round.
- **Per-CWD Thread Memory (`codexThreadsByCwd`)**: Rooms now index active Codex threads (and CLI agent sessions) per canonical project directory, so even cross-repo discussions (`Repo A -> Repo B -> Repo A`) seamlessly resume each repo's existing thread.
- **Accurate Mid-Room Thread Naming**: When genuinely opening a new thread for a different project folder mid-room, its Codex Desktop title now derives from the new topic prompt instead of repeating the room's initial Day-1 title.
- **Regression Suite**: Expanded automated test suite to `18/18` passing tests.
